notes: Galley — a story desk for a small newsroom (The Calder Weekly sample paper): a kanban desk moves stories pitch→assigned→draft→edit→ready→slotted with an enforced state machine that rejects illegal moves in plain language; an edition desk slots ready stories into sectioned print slots with holds that block publishing and a checklist-gated publish pass; a people desk manages writers with workload bars and enforced deactivation/reassignment rules; plus a ledger with search, filters, section chips, sorting, saved views (built-in + user), pagination and bulk actions (status, reassign, due bump, kill, archive), story drawer with notes, field history and validation, global undo/redo, command palette, full keyboard layer (g-chords, j/k, x, /, n, ?), activity log, archive with restore/delete-forever, first-run onboarding, JSON export/import (merge or replace with per-record conflict resolution) and CSV export, localStorage persistence with try/catch guards, debounced saves, a schema migration ladder with defensive repair, cross-tab BroadcastChannel change detection, and reset/wipe flows that offer a backup first. Fraunces and Inter variable fonts (SIL OFL) are bundled locally; no network is used at runtime. Verified in Chromium (in-app browser) at 1600px and 390px: all views render, full CRUD + rules battery passed, export/import round-trip passed, keyboard shortcuts passed, zero console errors observed during the sweep, storage survival across reload confirmed. Limitations: file:// operation was not verified in a live browser (scripts are classic non-module scripts and assets are relative, so it is expected to work); HTML5 drag-and-drop was verified via synthetic drag events rather than a physical pointer drag (the menu-based move path, used on touch and keyboard, was tested end to end); entrance animations can appear frozen in backgrounded/background-throttled tabs.
